# Expected — 05 hr-portal-harvest

| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| Type | scam |
| Family | Jobs |
| Expected label | **Scam markers: 3 or more** |
| Recovery branch | no |
| Purpose | The pure data theft: no money asked, everything taken by form — tests that the kit treats identity data as the payload |

## Markers that MUST appear (each quoted from the message)

| Category | Must quote |
|---|---|
| Information extraction | the portal's ask — "Social Security Number, bank account and routing numbers… and a photo of your driver's license" |
| Information extraction | the fallback — "reply to this email with the same details and we will enter them manually" |
| Urgency | "If it is not finished within 48 hours, your offer will be released to the next candidate" |
| Authority costume (false normalcy) | "This is standard pre-employment verification" |

## Markers that must NOT appear

- Payment shape — no money moves in this message; inventing a fee would be a false marker.

## Guards

- "Standard pre-employment verification" is flagged as the false-normalcy pattern: real verification happens after a real offer, through checkable channels, and never by email reply.
- The generic greeting ("Dear candidate") may be noted as supporting evidence — an onboarding portal that already "holds" an offer would know the name.
- Verify checklist: the hiring company's real HR channel, found by the user. No verdict.
